elements.label: Figure 2.2
elements.title: Important choices for designing standards, and the resulting trade-offs
elements.content:
Key design choices for standards: 
- Stringency: strict or lax
- Compliance: voluntary or mandatory
- Applicability: context specific or universal
- Flexibility: technology specific or outcome based
- Timing: early versus late
- Exclusiveness: open versus closed

Resulting trade-offs:
- Quality vs. Costs of compliance and enforcement
- Scale effects vs. Diversity
- Innovation vs. Technology lock-in
- Expertise vs. Capture
- Stakeholder involvement vs. Speed
- Short-term costs vs. Long-term benefits

Source: WDR 2025 team.
